channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Maharashtra nearing Maoist-free status, says Fadnavis; directs fresh security and development push
item.description: Fadnavis was speaking while presiding over a review meeting of the State-Level Committee on the National Plan and Action Framework. During the meeting, he issued a series of directives aimed at strengthening security arrangements and deepening development work in affected regions.

item.title: India's forex reserves up by $1.03 billion to $687.26 billion, gold reserves jump
item.description: Gold reserves increased by $1.188 billion to $106.984 billion during the week, the Central Bank said. The Special Drawing Rights (SDRs) were up by $93 million to $18.721 billion.

item.title: Govt exploring FTAs, RBI trade relief measures to mitigate US tariff impacts on textiles
item.description: Credit Guarantee Scheme for exporters and export promotion initiatives including a new Export Promotion Mission and GST reforms are other measures to mitigate the impact of US tariffs, MoS Pabitra Margherita said in a written reply to a question in Rajya Sabha on Friday.

item.title: US govt impersonation scam busted in Noida; Rs 1.88 crore recovered, 6 arrested
item.description: During the period 2022-2025, the accused individuals operating under pseudonymous identities of US Government officials from Drug Enforcement Agency (DEA), FBI and Social Security Administration (SSA), conspired to target US victims by threatening them that their Social Security Numbers (SSN) had been used for money laundering and drug deliveries and that all of their assets would be freezed.

item.title: Cabinet gives go ahead to 100 pc FDI in insurance sector
item.description: The Insurance Laws (Amendment) Bill 2025 is likely to be introduced during the ongoing winter session of Parliament which draws to an end on December 19.

item.title: Census 2027 gets Cabinet nod; digital count to deploy 30 lakh personnel and include caste data
item.description: Census 2027 will be the 16th national census and the 8th since Independence. Conducted under the Census Act, 1948 and Census Rules, 1990, the decennial exercise remains India's most comprehensive source of primary demographic, social, and economic data.

item.title: Silver surges past Rs 2 lakh/kg, gold prices jump nearly 2 pc
item.description: The price of the future contract expiring on March 5, 2026, rose over Rs 2,400 during the day before settling at Rs 2,00462, up Rs 1,520 against the previous session's closing of Rs 1,98,942.

item.title: After Eggs, Now Biscuits: J&K Battles Back-to-Back Food Safety Scares
item.description: Sulphite-laced biscuits banned in Anantnag as J&K government orders urgent probe into adulterated eggs reported across Kashmir Valley.

item.title: BB 19 winner Gaurav Khanna locks lips with wife; Akansha trolled for saying her gift is attending b'day party
item.description: Bigg Boss 19 winner Gaurav Khanna turned 44 on December 11, 2025, and celebrated his birthday on Thursday night with his wife Akansha, the BB 19 gang, and some of his closest friends from the industry. The actor hosted a celebration attended by Mridul Tiwari, Pranit More, Abhishek Bajaj, Ashnoor Kaur, Nehal, Kunickaa Sadanand with her son Ayaan, and Amaal Mallik.

item.title: J&K Congress Faces Internal Rift Over SC Cell Dispute, AICC In-charge to File Complaint
item.description: A fresh storm has hit the J&K Congress after leadership disowned SC Department chairman Karan Bhagat, calling his recent programme "unauthorised." AICC SC incharge Teena Choudhary condemned the move as defamatory and beyond the UT unit's authority, declaring that she will formally take up the issue with the high command.
